Name: Purple Coneflower
Author: OrangeGamingSystem
Description:
[size=3]Adds a new flower to the game, the Purple Coneflower. It is a regrowable crop that lasts through all seasons (except winter). This makes it really good for making honey, or as a gift.[/size]

[size=3]Specific Details:[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]Purchase Price: 180g
Sell Price: 85g
Initial Growth: 7 days
Regrowth: 5 days[/size][/spoiler]
[size=3]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/size]

[size=3]Installation is simple, unzip the mod and put it in your Mods folder.[/size]

Manifest.Name: Purple Coneflower (Perennial Flower)
Manifest.Description: Adds the Purple Coneflower, a regrowable flower that survives all year. Great for making honey!
